scientific_question: When every record copies T6's exact K_i and special-token contract, does terminal-tail placement retain an advantage over uniformly placed contiguous Random-PR supervision?

records.order: Frozen training_records list order; batch size 1; no DataLoader or shuffle.

mask_rng.algorithm: Python stdlib Mersenne Twister random.Random; one sequential randrange draw per frozen training-record order

random_pr_mask.mask_rule: For record i, copy T6 K_i and special positions; sample s_i uniformly from all integer starts 0..T_i-K_i and activate [s_i,s_i+K_i).

lora.initialization_rule: Unmodified pilot_core.LoRALinear Kaiming-uniform lora_A and zero lora_B; apply the pair init_seed immediately before inject_lora; no old adapter/checkpoint load.

training_contract.only_variable_relative_to_matching_T6: speech-label placement from frozen T6 terminal tail to the one frozen Random-PR interval
